 2024:KER:82461 WP(C)No.27016, 27951, 28300, 28713, 28816 & 28856 of 2024  7  JUDGMENT
All these writ petitions are connected.
The property of all the petitioners were acquired and awards were passed.
Though the petitioners accepted the award amount under protest, they did not file any application for reference in time.

However, in view of the enhancement granted to the similarly situated lands vide LAR No. 617/2009, the petitioners filed separate applications (Ext.P1) for enhancement of compensation before the 1st respondent under Sec.28A of the Land Acquisition Act as early as in 2015.
The grievance of the petitioners is that even after a lapse of 8 years, the District Collector has not disposed of their applications.
2. I have heard the learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Government Pleader.

The competent authority is directed to dispose of the applications (Ext.P1) filed under Sec.28A of the Land Acquisition Act preferred by the petitioners within a period of four months from the date of receipt of the certified copy of this judgment.
The writ petitions are disposed of as above.

Sd/-

However, in view of the enhancement granted to the similarly situated lands vide LAR No. 617/2009, the petitioners filed separate applications (Ext.P1) for enhancement of compensation before the 1st respondent under Sec.28A of the Land Acquisition Act as early as in 2015.
